data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":[],"disanalogies":["Garbage collection is deterministic, whereas argumentative criticism is probabilistic and dialectical.","Garbage collection targets unreachable objects, while rival positions are highly reachable but ignored."],"overturn_conditions":["If the coverage debt is not the primary driver of survival for older rival positions, tracing them will not increase retirement."],"shared_structure":["Both systems accumulate unaddressed objects/rivals that must be actively traced and retired to prevent memory/logic bloat.","Both require a deterministic policy to scan and clear residue rather than relying on incidental interactions."],"source_memory_refs":["wikipedia:garbage_collection"],"transfer_claims":["Introducing a generational or debt-weighted tracing policy will improve system efficiency by cleaning up long-standing residue."]},"claim":"Implementing a coverage-debt amortization queue in the criticism mechanism will increase the retirement rate of older rival positions from near-zero to at least 15% per batch by forcing attention allocation proportional to accumulated debt.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The amortization queue introduces a starvation risk for genuinely novel positions if debt thresholds are too aggressive.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The 15% retirement rate is purely speculative without a sandboxed simulation of the queue dynamics.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"Older positions might survive criticism due to unresolvable structural analogies, not just coverage neglect.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The criticism-weighted attention currently allows new rival positions to dominate attention. By tracking a per-position coverage debt and routing a fraction of batched criticism to the highest-debt positions, older positions that have evaded criticism will be actively retired, effectively emptying the standing residue described in the documentation.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
